answers.core: It would make the TextureRegion panels navigation consistent with other 2D panels, namely the main one.
answers.workaround:
It can be worked around in the following ways:
* manually clicking and dragging the scroll bars 
* zooming right out with mouse wheel, moving cursor to desired position and zooming right back in

Neither are intuitive or efficient methods of navigation.

title: Allow panning the TextureRegion window with right click
